args.summary: The v2.3.1 deploy of checkout-api caused failed health checks across all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of ~18%. Mitigation: rolled back all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. Post-rollback verification: all regions on v2.3.0, service healthy, error rate ~0.2%. Root cause of the v2.3.1 failure is not yet known and should be investigated before any redeploy.

Done. Summary:

1. **Diagnosed the issue**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.
2. **Identified rollback target**: from the deployment history, v2.3.0 was the most recent release that was healthy in production (v2.3.1-rc was only in staging and never healthy).
3. **Rolled back to v2.3.0 in all regions**: the first rollback attempt partially failed (completed us-east only, halted by an orchestrator error), so I retried — the retry completed the rollout to us-west and eu-west.
4. **Verified recovery**: all regions are now on v2.3.0, healthy, with error rate down to ~0.2%.
5. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0001) describing the failure and the mitigation steps. The initial incident-creation call timed out, but I confirmed via `list_incidents` that it was created successfully, so no duplicate was filed.
